about.narrative:
Seasoned Java engineer with 9+ years designing and building scalable, high-performance business applications — backend development, microservices architecture, and technical leadership, with a track record of improving software quality, system performance, and engineering workflows.

My way of working is rooted in systems thinking — a holistic view of the big picture together with the ability to dive deep into the implementation detail of complex systems.

A background in sales and project management gives me a product-focused perspective: aligning engineering effort with business goals and communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

I use AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools as productivity multipliers for development, debugging, refactoring, testing, and technical research, and I'm adopting agentic coding workflows.
highlights: Projects spanning legacy systems to greenfield startups
Teams from co-located to hundreds worldwide
Deep Java, relational-database and distributed-systems expertise
